usedFor: Connecteam holds your team members, and Calendly creates a booking link with “Create Scheduling Link” after “New User”.

bestTemplate.name: “New User” in Connecteam, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A new teammate usually needs a first meeting, and the action creates a link they can book.

watchOut: “User Restored Archived” is a separate trigger from “New User”, so a restored person will not get a link.
